freePolicy.note: 每門逐步課程只開放第一節（第一個階段）免費試學；其餘階段需有效學習通行證。
freePolicy.noteEn: Only the first section (first stage) of every guided course is free; all other stages require an active learning pass.

rounding: Convert TWD × rate, then round UP to a tidy price (HuaTuo rule): zero-decimal currencies to whole units, in steps of 10/100/1,000 at ≥1,000/10,000/100,000; two-decimal currencies to whole units at ≥100, otherwise to the next .49 or .99. Never below TWD × rate.
currencyRegion: Interface language first (single-country languages decide the region), then time zone, then browser language region; the learner may choose manually.
